
```jsx
import { CxOffcanvas } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxOffcanvas from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/offcanvas/CxOffcanvas'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **backdrop** | Apply a backdrop on body while offcanvas is open. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the base component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **keyboard** | Closes the offcanvas when escape key is pressed | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **onHide** | Callback fired when the component requests to be hidden. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onShow** | Callback fired when the component requests to be shown. | `(() => void)` \| `undefined` | - |
| **placement** | Components placement, there’s no default placement. | `'start'` \| `'end'` \| `'top'` \| `'bottom'` | - |
| **portal** | Generates modal using createPortal. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | true |
| **scroll** | Allow body scrolling while offcanvas is open | `boolean` \| `undefined` | false |
| **visible** | Toggle the visibility of offcanvas component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | false |
